name: Čistá typografia / flat vektor
summary: Bez fotografie a bez ľudí. Dominuje extra tučná typografia na jednoliatom pozadí, doplnená tenkým vektorovým tvarom ako tichý vodoznak.
when_to_use: Lead gen a služby, kde fotka len ruší. Ďalej flash/sale, kde má cena alebo zľava kričať a byť prečítaná za pol sekundy.
prompt_block: Render the entire image as a flat vector graphic with no photograph and no people. Background is one solid flat colour with no gradient noise and no photographic texture. Typography dominates the canvas: very bold heavy sans-serif, generously spaced, left-aligned, with the key word or number rendered noticeably larger and in the accent colour. Any decorative shape is a single thin outline form, heavily cropped so it bleeds off two edges, tinted so light that it reads as a quiet watermark and never competes with the text. Buttons are solid rounded rectangles with a flat fill. No gradients, no 3D, no drop shadows, no bevels, no photographic elements anywhere.
never: photographs or photorealistic renders of any kind
gradients, glows, bevels or drop shadows
